blocks.text: Calix Esguerra may have been one of the first two evictees of “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3,” but there is still reason for him to hold his head up as he enjoys the support of his fellow pageant kings. Three reigning titleholders of the Misters of Filipinas pageant, where the reality TV personality earned his national crown last year, came to Esguerra’s defense amid all the criticism that he has received from viewers. Inquirer Entertainment sat with Mister Fitness Supermodel World Philippines Jeriko Reyes, Mister United World Philippines Vincent Mark Caringal, and Mister Global Asian Philippines Klyde San Diego at […]...
